model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the overall performance (%) of various large language models (LLMs) in the EBS-AOS pattern, as referenced in the paper “Benchmarking Large Language Models for Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization,” with the caption specifying that the data represents 0.90% of all LLMs evaluated. The vertical axis is labeled “Overall Performance (%)” and ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 20, using a linear scale. The horizontal axis displays ten distinct categories, each represented by a single bar with its exact performance percentage labeled on top. The bars are arranged in descending order of performance from left to right, starting with the highest at 76.24% and ending with the lowest at 34.24%. The bars are colored differently for visual distinction: the first bar is teal (76.24%), the second is dark purple (73.94%), the third is muted pink (72.09%), the fourth is light blue (77.12%), the fifth is light brown (46.02%), the sixth is lavender (76.71%), the seventh is light orange (67.58%), the eighth is beige (63.63%), the ninth is light gray (66.50%), and the tenth is pale pink (64.34%). The caption provides a stratification scheme dividing models into three tiers based on their OP_{GM} score: Tier-1 (72–77), Tier-2 (64–68), and Tier-3 (34–46). Visually, the chart shows that models with performance values above 72% fall into Tier-1, those between 64% and 68% fall into Tier-2, and the model with 34.24% falls into Tier-3. The bars are not grouped or stacked; each represents a single model’s performance. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their distinct colors and labels.
